Exhausted retries fall through to the existing 502 `api_error` handler.

pr.title: Fix #1907: retry upstream ECONNRESET pre-stream; emit SSE error mid-stream
pr.description:
Fixes #1907. The gateway's `/v1/messages` proxy previously let `httpx.ReadError`
from an upstream TCP reset propagate out of the streaming generator, truncating
the SSE to the agent and causing a fatal `socket connection was closed
unexpectedly` error that killed the sandbox Job.

Adds two complementary defenses in `proxy_anthropic_messages`:
  (A) Pre-stream retry (max 1) when the upstream read fails before any byte has
      reached the downstream agent — covers stale keepalive connections and
      early edge resets. Transparent to the agent.
  (B) Mid-stream synthetic `event: error` SSE envelope when the reset fires
      after bytes have flowed. The agent sees a well-formed error event
      matching Anthropic's convention instead of a truncated stream, avoiding
      the downstream `aclose(): asynchronous generator is already running`
      crash.

Non-streaming and `/v1/messages/count_tokens` paths are unchanged.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: new `gateway/tests/test_proxy_anthropic_stream.py` covers (a) early
  reset retried successfully, (b) persistent early reset returns 502, (c)
  mid-stream reset emits terminating SSE error event, (d) partial transcript
  capture still runs on mid-stream error. Existing gateway suite (`pytest
  gateway/tests/`) must continue passing.
- Manual: not required — behavior is purely defensive; no user-facing API
  surface changes.

`upstream_reset_midstream` (WARN) structured events to confirm the fix
